item.title: Two Plastic barriers causing severe obstruction to pedestrians and in particular to disabled people in wherlchsirs, 2nd August
item.description:
There have been two large barriers on the pavement in Montpellier Street for several months now. I assume these have been placed there in advance of work needed to repair some steps and paving. Although I can understand the logic in placing these in order to minimise any likely cause due to ‘wonky steps and paving’, the barriers themselves have and continue to cause problems for pedestrians (in particularly disabled people in wheelchairs). There is insufficient room to navigate the pavement and if attempting to do so, one is likely to step on the road or potentially trip in the undulated paving surrounding the barriers. It’s been going on for far too long (several months) and I fear nothing is ever going to be done. Quite honestly it’s a real hazard (and eyesore) and will likely cause someone real harm to someone very soon. My wife and I have both nearly tripped up when trying get round and now find ourselves having to avoid the area altogether. Would someone please let me know when work will commence to rectify the situation. It is well over due. Many thanks

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Montpellier Walk, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Issue with pedestrian crossing sensor/sequence, 1st August
item.description:
Problem with the pedestrian crossing button/sensor when crossing over Southam Lane from the Evesham Road side to the Cheltenham Road side (corner of the rugby club). When pressing the button to cross, the button lights up red but most times the light will go off again after a few seconds, with the green man stage being missed from the sequence. Sometimes to cross here you have to press the button multiple times and wait through two or three complete sequences before the green man stage works.
